parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required when using Alibaba Cloud AccessKey (AK) and SecretKey (SK) or Security Token Service (STS) temporary authorization.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Clone account for remote synchronization repository

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/
